en: A sepia-toned or black-and-white postcard showing a large castle-like structure positioned on a hill overlooking a small town. The structure is massive with multiple floors, towers, and architectural features typical of old European castles or palaces. Surrounding the castle is a forested area, and at the bottom of the hill is a cluster of residential and industrial buildings. There is some text printed in red at the bottom left that reads 'Schloss Colditz.' Additional text on the side reads '437. Brüder & Sohn, Meissen.'
